names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ευλόγιος ο Ξενοδόχος», with the rank word left off; the page explains the epithet itself, that he was called Ξενοδόχος because the whole care and delight of his life was to receive strangers in his house.

The two words the day’s line and the life’s own title both use — «Прав. Евлогия странноприимца» and «Праведный Евлогий Странноприимец» — with the rank word stripped per BRIEF.md §4. «Странноприимец», the hospitaller, the receiver of strangers, is not a rank word but the epithet by which this calendar knows him, and it is capitalised in both page titles. The name index at page 686 is titled «Евлогий Странноприимец, Фиваидский» and adds a THIRD word, «Фиваидский», of the Thebaid, which neither the line nor the life title repeats and which is not joined to the stored form here. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'евлогии странноприимец' has no other holder.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 апреля ст. ст. — «Прав. Евлогия странноприимца (VI).»

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. A CENTURY CONFLICT INSIDE THE ONE SOURCE, AND NO `dates` WAS WRITTEN: the line heads him «(VI)», the sixth century, while the life it links, life942, opens «Праведный Евлогий Странноприимец жил в IV веке в Фиваиде», the fourth. The folder held no date of any kind and still holds none; a century read off a line that its own life contradicts by two hundred years is not a date, and `date-display.js` would take either of them happily, which is exactly why neither was written. THE WHOLE OF THE LIFE IS TWO SENTENCES — «Он нес подвиг служения странникам», he carried the ascetic labour of serving travellers — and it adds one thing the folder did not have, THE THEBAID, which the name page repeats in its own title. `types` unchanged: the line’s «Прав.», праведный, is the `righteous` the folder already carries. The page heads «День памяти: 27 апреля» — one day, with no second. The day page prints nine hymns, three under the kinsman of the Lord and six under the abbot of the Caves, and NONE under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ευλόγιος ο Ξενοδόχος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It places him in the parts of the Thebaid in Egypt, makes his trade that of a quarryman or stonecutter, and says he lived more than a hundred years and died in peace; **it gives no year at all, so there is no `dates` object.** The line «Βυζαντινός γραμματικός του 5ου μ.Χ. αιώνα» that stands under the name heading is saint.gr's gloss on the *name* Ευλόγιος, about a Byzantine grammarian of the fifth century, and is not a statement about this saint; it is not used here. The corpus's three other men of the name are other people — Eulogius of Palestine is a martyr of 5 March who went about Palestine as a beggar, and Eulogius of Alexandria and Eulogius of Edessa are hierarchs. It prints no hymn and names no relic.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
